input: A schema of settings fields from a layout contract (label, widget id, settings path, named choices or a number, default, a condition to show under) and the JSON settings draft of the owner.
output: The fields drawn in a grid; what the user changed written into the draft (choices as text, numbers parsed with a comma as decimal point). The owner writes the draft; this piece never stores anything.
specification: Audit 2026-10-10: the Project Advanced fields lived as code in the form (qnc-project-blocks); they are now a schema in contracts/ui/project.layout.json drawn by this piece.
